verdict.rationale: The evidence implies Benchmark supports private sending domains with a verification status, since the API exposes that status read-only and has a 'domains' permission scope. That suggests the product's own domain authentication exists, but its depth is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit SPF, DKIM and DMARC alignment support, a guided DNS record setup flow, in-app verification steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can authenticate my own sending domain — SPF, DKIM, DMARC alignment — with guided DNS setup and verification

citations.quote: Read-only access to the verification status of your private sending domains.
Per-resource permissions: No Access, Read, or Read & Write (contacts, campaigns, reports, domains)
